name: closest pair not adjacent in x order
random small cases match exhaustive oracle
input: 30 seeded point sets of size 2 to 12
test:
import math
import random
rng = random.Random(20261001)
for size in range(2, 12):
    for _ in range(3):
        points = [[rng.randrange(-20, 21), rng.randrange(-20, 21)] for _ in range(size)]
        expected = min(math.dist(points[i], points[j]) for i in range(size) for j in range(i + 1, size))
        assert abs(closest_pair_distance(points) - expected) <= 1e-5

name: twenty thousand points with a known nearest pair
test:
points = [[index * 500, 0] for index in range(20000)]
points[10000][0] = points[9999][0] + 1
before = [point[:] for point in points]
assert abs(closest_pair_distance(points) - 1) <= 1e-5
assert points == before
